intro: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun in Ratchet has had enough of his merchant vessels being blasted to splinters by the Alliance gunners at Northwatch Hold. He hires Horde champions to march down the Merchant Coast, silence the hold's artillery officers, and take the badges of their fallen infantry.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Yet another ship from my fleet has been lost to those overzealous humans at Northwatch Hold!
Those bastards must be dealt with. Their paranoia has them in a state of frenzy. Trigger happy, reckless louts are shooting at anything in their sights.

Travel south along the Merchant Coast to the Hold and lay siege to their forces. Bring me the medals of their soldiers as proof. And for the love of my fleet, slay Captain Fairmount and her overzealous cannoneers!

clips.title: Progress
paras: My fleet is in peril with Captain Fairmount and her damned cannoneers blasting away from Northwatch Hold. I want her soldiers to pay as well. Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Alas, the righteous Alliance guns have been silenced. You shall be rewarded for your aid, friend.
Now to tend to the grim task of recovering the bodies of the dead....
